items.q: What size projects do you take on?
items.a: Everything from a single firmware module or machine to full production-line automation. If it involves hardware, firmware, controls or connectivity, we can help — and we'll tell you honestly if we're not the right fit.
After a short discovery call we provide a fixed-price proposal for well-scoped work, or a transparent time-and-materials rate for R&D and ongoing support. No surprises.

items.q: Do you work remotely or on-site?
items.a: Both. Most design, firmware and PLC development happens remotely, with on-site commissioning, testing and training as needed anywhere worldwide.
Yes — optional support packages cover troubleshooting, remote monitoring, firmware updates and continuous improvement after go-live.

items.q: Who owns the IP and source code?
items.a: You do. On delivery you receive full source, CAD, documentation and a clean handover. Your product is yours.
